Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_Enabled_toolti: Open containers of liquid spill when carried in bags or pockets while you move.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_DirtyContainer: Spills dirty the bag or clothing
A container that something spilled in becomes dirty and needs washing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_WetClothing: Spills wet bags and worn clothing
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_WetClothing_to: A spill wets the bag it happened in, and the clothing you are wearing if the bag is worn or the spill is in your pockets. Only liquids wet things: spilled food only stains.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FoodSpillage_t: Loose food in a carried bag is crushed, losing nutrition and dirtying the bag. Turn off to leave only liquids spilling.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_AtFullRules_to: Some foods are safe in a bag only while whole and become spillable once eaten from (an opened packet, a started bar). Turn off to make them spill like any other food.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_AtFullAsSealed: Every food with an "At 100%%" rule never spills, even after it has been eaten from, as if opened cans and packets stay sealed. Overrides the option above.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_EmptyDurationS: How long emptying a spilled-in bag takes (about, at normal game speed). A worn or held bag is also taken off and put back on around it.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_UnattendedVehi: Cargo in a vehicle with nobody in it still spills while it rolls, as long as a player is within this many tiles. 0 turns this off. Single player only: in multiplayer an empty vehicle cannot roll, so this setting has no effect there.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleSpills_: Things you carry, and loose cargo in a vehicle's seats, trunk and glovebox, spill according to the vehicle's speed. Turn off to make vehicles spill-free.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_TowedVehicleSp: Cargo in a vehicle that is being towed spills as it travels, along with anyone riding in it. Has no effect if vehicles cause spills is off.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_HotSpillBurns_: Hot food or drink spilling in your pockets burns you at once; spilled inside a bag you wear, it burns once it soaks through to your skin a few minutes later. Burns on the torso or legs are much weaker than fire burns and heal sooner.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FoodSpillsInPo: Food you carry loose in your own pockets (not in a bag) spills as you move. Turn off to make only food loose in a bag spill. Has no effect if food spillage is off.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ScentMultiplie: How strong the scent from spilled items is: 1 is the default, 2 doubles how far it carries, 0 removes it. Only used when spilled items give off scent.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SpilledScent: Spilled Items Give Off 'Starving Zombies' Scent
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SpilledScent_t: Needs the Starving Zombies mod and Dirty containers. Spilled food and edible drinks leave a smell on the bag or clothing they soak into, which makes zombies notice you from further away until it is washed out. It is strongest while the spilled food is still inside a bag; washing takes it out, a partial wash only part of it. Spilled food smells stronger than drinks; water, fuel and bleach have no smell. Vehicle cargo does not count.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepAfterMinut: How many in-game minutes you carry a bag with something spilled inside before it starts to seep: the spill soaks into your clothing (a bag worn, on a hotbar slot or loose in your pockets) and food spilled in it goes off. A bag held in a hand seeps too, but wets and dirties nothing. Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_HotSeepAfterMi: Same, for a bag with a hot spill inside: it reaches your skin and can burn you. Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepWetPerStep: How much wetness (out of 100) a soaked bag, worn or in your pockets, pours onto your clothing every 10 in-game minutes. Default 75.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagDryPerHour: Bag drying: wetness lost per hour (carried)
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagDryPerHour_: How much wetness (out of 100) a bag loses per in-game hour while it dries (half as fast while worn). Default 40.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagRainPerHour: How much wetness (out of 100) a worn bag gains per hour in full rain. Default 100.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagSweatPerHou: How much wetness (out of 100) a worn bag gains per hour while sweat soaks through your clothes. Default 100.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BurnChancePerc: Chance that one hot spill burns you: per spill in your pockets, and for a worn bag per hot spill that soaked through (the chances add up when several spilled). Default 25.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BurnTimeMin_to: How strong the burn is from a spill that is only just hot. For comparison, fire burns are 50 to 100. Default 0.1.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BurnTimeMax_to: How strong the burn is from a spill at the hottest an item gets. Default 2.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FoodScentPerPo: How far (in tiles) zombies smell you for each whole portion of food spilled on your bag or clothing. Default 6.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_LiquidScentPer: The same for each litre of an edible drink spilled. Default 3.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ScentCapPerIte: Most scent per bag or garment (tiles)
The most scent one bag or piece of clothing can hold. Default 8.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ScentMaxTotal_: The most scent that is added to you in all, from everything you carry and wear. Default 24.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionGeneral: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionMovemen: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionFood_to: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionVehicle: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionBags_to: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionHot_too: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionScent_t: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SpillIntervalS: While you keep moving (or a vehicle keeps going), one spill happens this often. The percentages below are what a container loses with each spill, so a bigger number makes everything spill more slowly. Default 3.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleSpeedId: A vehicle slower than this does not spill anything. Default 3.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleSpeedCr: Speeds from the idle limit up to this are a crawl. Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleSpeedCi: Speeds from the crawl limit up to this are town speed. Default 45.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleSpeedRo: Speeds from the town limit up to this are road speed; anything faster is highway speed. Default 80.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateSneakL: Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while sneaking (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 10.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateSneakF: Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while sneaking (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 5.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateWalkLi: Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while walking (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateWalkFo: Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while walking (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 10.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateRunLiq: Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while running (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 25.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateRunFoo: Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while running (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 12.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FootRateSprint: Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while sprinting (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 40.
Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while sprinting (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VaultSpillLiqu: Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost each time you climb over a fence, window or wall (vaulting), and each time you stumble or fall: trip, get bumped, get knocked down or fall from a height. All of these count as the same kind of event; a trip, bump, knock-down or fall within 3 seconds of another does not count twice. Default 75.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VaultSpillFood: Percent of a portion of food lost each time you climb over a fence, window or wall (vaulting), and each time you stumble or fall: trip, get bumped, get knocked down or fall from a height. All of these count as the same kind of event; a trip, bump, knock-down or fall within 3 seconds of another does not count twice. Default 25.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleRateCra: Vehicle crawling: liquid lost per spill (%%)

Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while the vehicle travels crawling (above the idle speed, up to the crawl speed) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 5.
Vehicle crawling: food lost per spill (%%)

Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while the vehicle travels crawling (above the idle speed, up to the crawl speed) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 0.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleRateCit: Vehicle in town: liquid lost per spill (%%)

Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while the vehicle travels in town (up to the town speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 10.
Vehicle in town: food lost per spill (%%)
Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while the vehicle travels in town (up to the town speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 2.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleRateRoa: Vehicle on the road: liquid lost per spill (%%)

Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while the vehicle travels on the road (up to the road speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 25.
Vehicle on the road: food lost per spill (%%)
Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while the vehicle travels on the road (up to the road speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 5.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_VehicleRateHig: Vehicle on the highway: liquid lost per spill (%%)

Percent of a liquid container's full amount lost with each spill while the vehicle travels on the highway (faster than the road speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Also used for drinks such as tea in a mug. Default 40.
Vehicle on the highway: food lost per spill (%%)
Percent of a portion of food lost with each spill while the vehicle travels on the highway (faster than the road speed limit) (one spill every few seconds, see Seconds between spills). Default 15.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_DirtLiquidPerc: How much dirt (out of 100%%) a bag or garment gets each time a small amount of a liquid (1 cl) spills in it. Water never dirties. Default 2.5.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_DirtFoodPercen: How much dirt (out of 100%%) a bag or garment gets each time a small amount of food (5%% of a portion) is crushed in it. Default 10.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_WetnessPerLitr: Wetness from a spill, per litre
How much wetness (out of 100) a spill puts on your clothing or a bag for each litre spilled. Only liquids wet things. Default 500, so 0.2 litres soaks completely.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepDirtPercen: Only if seepage dirties clothing: how much dirt (out of 100%%) a soaked bag, worn or in your pockets, leaves on your clothing every 10 in-game minutes. Default 5.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepDirt_toolt: A bag with a stain soaks the stain into the clothing under it (worn, or loose in the pockets), not just the wetness. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ColdLiquidsSaf: Liquids do not freeze in the game, so a cold drink (shown blue in your inventory, from a fridge or freezer) counts as frozen and cannot spill. Turn off to make cold liquids spill like any other. On by default.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_RainSweatWetsB: Rain and sweat wet worn bags

A bag you wear gets wet from rain and from sweat soaking through your clothes, and does not dry while it is being rained on. Turn off so that only spills wet bags. Only used when spills wet bags and clothing is on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepMinWet: Seepage needs a bag this wet (%%)
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepMinWet_too: A worn, spilled-in bag has to be at least this wet (out of 100) before it wets your clothing. Default 25, the point where the game calls clothing Wet.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepMinDirtPer: Seepage dirt needs a bag this dirty (%%)
Only if seepage dirties clothing: a bag, worn or in your pockets, has to be at least this dirty (out of 100%%) before it dirties your clothing. Default 50.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ContentsWetPer: Wetness spreading inside a bag, per 10 minutes

How much wetness (out of 100) a wet, spilled-in bag passes to the things loose inside it every 10 in-game minutes, up to the bag's own wetness. The default is high enough that they soak at once. Default 1000.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ContentsDirtPe: Dirt spreading inside a bag, per 10 minutes (%%)

How much dirt (out of 100%%) a stained, spilled-in bag passes to the things loose inside it every 10 in-game minutes, up to the bag's own dirt. Dirt gets around more easily inside a bag than through it. Default 10.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ScentSpilledFa: Scent while spilled food has gone off in a bag (times)

Once what spilled in a bag has gone off (when its seepage starts, the same moment the Bad Smell moodle appears), the bag smells this many times as strong as the stain alone. Until then it smells like the stain. If "Spilled food goes off in bags" is off, this applies from the spill. Default 2.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ScentEmptiedFa: Scent of emptied bags and clothing (times)
The same for a bag that was emptied but not washed, and for clothing that something spilled on. 1 is the strength of the stain itself. Default 1.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SectionFizz_to: Section heading. This setting does nothing.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FizzEnabled_to: A carbonated drink (soda, beer...) that is opened after you have been running or sprinting foams over and loses part of its contents on top of what you drink. Only counts exercise on foot; driving does not shake a drink. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FizzMaxLossPer: Foam lost at a full shake (%%)
How much of a full drink foams away when it is opened right after a full shake. Less for a smaller shake. Default 60.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FizzFullShakeS: Seconds of sprinting for a full shake
How long you have to sprint to shake a drink fully. Running counts half as much, and each fence or window you climb counts one second. Default 8.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FizzFadeSecond: How quickly the shake calms down once you stop: it halves every this many seconds. Default 5.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_WasherFillsCon: A bag being washed ruins what is directly inside it in open vessels: an open container (a mug, a bowl, a pot...) is filled with a random amount of water, once per wash, and whatever was in it is lost; any food in an open vessel (soup in a bowl, pasta in a pot) becomes the empty vessel holding water. Containers inside a nested bag are shielded. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_DryerEmptiesOp: A bag in a running dryer loses what is in the open containers directly inside it: a liquid is emptied completely (sealed containers are safe), and a liquid food (soup, tea...) loses nutrition while the cycle runs, see the next option. Other foods are not affected. Containers inside a nested bag are shielded. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_DryerNutrition: How much nutrition a drink-like food in an open vessel loses every 5 in-game minutes in a running dryer, in the units of the food (a bowl of soup holds 15, a mug of tea 20, a bucket of soup 40). It is scaled by how liquid the food is: tea (all thirst) loses the full amount, soup (half thirst) half of it. A dry cycle lasts 90 minutes. When all is gone it becomes its empty vessel. Default 2.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SeepInheritPer: Seepage trickles down the body: the first garment under a soaked bag (worn, or in your pockets) gets the full amount every 10 minutes, and each next one (legs, then feet, then torso, arms and head) gets a share of what the one before it got, for as long as the bag is not emptied. This is the most it passes on, for a fully soaked bag; a barely wet bag passes on much less, so light seepage stays on the first garments and heavy seepage runs all the way down. 0 = only the first garment. Default 60.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_FoamInheritPer: Foam from a fizzy drink wets and stains the garments in order, and each next one gets a share of what the one before it got. This is the most it passes on, when the foam soaks the first garment through; a small foam passes on much less and stays on the first garment or two. 0 = only the first garment. Default 60.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_AutoEquipAtFul: Hold "At 100%%" items when eating or drinking part of them

Eating or drinking only some of an "At 100%%" item (a full bottle, an unopened packet) first takes it into your hands, so what is left does not go back into the bag, where it would spill: it goes into a free hand, or replaces the primary hand item (a two-handed item empties both hands). Turn off for vanilla behaviour: the item goes back where it was. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_GracefulReduce: A Graceful character loses this much less to spilling on foot and to drinks foaming over. 50 = 50%% less. Default 50.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_ClumsyIncrease: A Clumsy character loses this much more to spilling on foot and to drinks foaming over. 40 = 40%% more. Default 40.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagsSour: Spilled food goes off in bags
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_BagsSour_toolt: When seepage from a bag with anything but water spilled in it starts (see "Seepage starts after"), what spilled has gone off: food, drinks, fuel and other liquids smell. Carrying the bag in the open (not shut in another bag) gives the Bad Smell moodle, its lowest level; it never gets worse than that, and it goes away when the bag is emptied or washed. Water never goes off. Default on.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SpeedDemonRedu: Speed Demon: less spilled when driving (%%)
When the driver is a Speed Demon, everything in the vehicle loses this much less to spilling, whoever carries it (loose cargo, and what the driver and passengers carry). 25 = 25%% less. Default 25.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SundayDriverIn: Sunday Driver: more spilled when driving (%%)
When the driver is a Sunday Driver, everything in the vehicle loses this much more to spilling, whoever carries it (loose cargo, and what the driver and passengers carry). 33 = 33%% more. Default 33.
Sandbox_DontSpillTheBeans_SmellRadius_to: A bag that has gone off and lies on the ground gives the Bad Smell moodle to anyone within this many tiles, on the same floor. Bags in your own inventory always do. 0 = a bag on the ground does not smell. Default 3.
